_comment: What the operator is being asked to test in the F10 Cloud dev panel right now. The panel paints a red TEST tag beside every row whose label starts with 'label' and lists these at the top. Edit this file (it is read live while the panel is open); the chat names the same labels in bold. Remove an entry when its question is answered.

tests.label: Sun shadow cache
tests.note: Default on since v0.1288. Inside any deck: untick, compare the look and the FPS, retick. Expected: same look within a couple of levels, about 3x faster.

tests.label: Body cluster cache
tests.note: Default on since v0.1288. Same test as the sun cache. Weak spot: looking across a cumulus field from below, where it roughly breaks even.

tests.label: step economy
tests.note: Default 1.0 since v0.1288. Drag to 0 anywhere far from the deck (orbit, high altitude): the clouds should look the same and the FPS drop.

tests.label: Field walls
tests.note: Leave OFF. A null instrument from v0.1281 that costs about 10 percent.
